⚔️ YAKUZA: KENZAN! gets a native Windows and Linux recompilation with English translation, 4K resolution and 120 FPS! 🔥

Developer IvanBarbosaFilho has released v1.0.0 Beta of Ryu ga Gotoku Kenzan!, bringing the 2008 Japan-exclusive PlayStation 3 adventure to modern PCs using ps3recomp!

🔥 FEATURES:

✅ NATIVE WINDOWS & LINUX — Original PS3 PPU and SPU code recompiled into native PC code!

✅ ENGLISH TRANSLATION — Community translation automatically applied during installation!

✅ 120 FPS SUPPORT — Selectable 30, 60 and 120 FPS modes without increasing gameplay speed!

✅ ENHANCED GRAPHICS — Vulkan rendering, up to 4K resolution, SMAA, FXAA, MSAA, sharpening and anisotropic filtering!

✅ MINIGAME SUPPORT — Including mahjong, shogi, bowling, archery, turtle racing and more!

✅ MODERN CONTROLS — Remappable keyboard and mouse inputs, controller support, in-game settings and compatibility with original PS3 and RPCS3 saves!

⚠️ BETA RELEASE — The entire game is reportedly playable, but testing across different hardware remains limited.

💿 Requires your own decrypted Japanese PS3 game (BLJM60064 v1.00), the community English translation patch and approximately 25 GB of free storage.

A dedicated launcher handles installation without requiring manual compilation.

🛠️ Developed by IvanBarbosaFilho using ps3recomp and the inFAMOUS 2 PC port runtime.

🌍 Credit to majDima, Arcodeaus, jurxd, PauseForTheCat and TheEdgyNerd for the English translation, and Pakundo for the frame-rate patches.

⭐ Support the project with a GitHub star!

⚔️ FIRE EMBLEM WARRIORS gets a native Windows and Linux recompilation with dedicated Steam Deck optimisations! 🔥

Developer Azzulin has released FEW Recomp v0.2.0, bringing the 2017 Nintendo Switch adventure to PC using the HWDER recompilation runtime!

🔥 FEATURES:

✅ STATIC RECOMPILATION — Original ARM64 game code converted into a native x86-64 program with Vulkan rendering!

✅ NATIVE STEAM DECK SUPPORT — No Proton or separate Windows PC required!

✅ 60 FPS SUPPORT — Windows battles at 720p or optional 1080p, with selectable 30 FPS and 60 FPS modes!

✅ DLC SUPPORT — All five DLC packages supported using your original game files!

✅ HANDHELD OPTIMISATIONS — Dedicated Zen 2 compilation, improved GPU efficiency and original particle effects preserved!

✅ AUTOMATED BUILD SYSTEM — Automatic toolchain downloads, resumable compilation, background shader caching and Steam shortcut creation!

⚠️ EARLY RELEASE — Demanding battles can still dip below 30 FPS on Steam Deck. Ultrawide, increased resolution scaling and 120 FPS enhancements are not currently available.

📱 Android support is a future ambition, but development has not yet started.

💿 Requires your own US copy of Fire Emblem Warriors, update 1.5.0 and console keys. The source-only release includes automated scripts to compile the game locally.

🛠️ Developed by Azzulin using the HWDER v0.3.5 runtime.

⭐ Support the project with a GitHub star!

results.text:
🔥 POKÉMON LEGENDS: ARCEUS gets a native PC recompilation with 120 FPS support and ultrawide enhancements!

Developer CarlosExabyte has released Arceuszada v1.2.0 UltraWide Fix, an independent static recompilation project bringing the 2022 Nintendo Switch adventure to Windows!

🔥 FEATURES:

✅ HIGH FRAME RATES — 30, 60, 90 and 120 FPS options without increasing gameplay speed!

✅ ULTRAWIDE SUPPORT — 16:9, 21:9 and 32:9 display modes with corrected interface scaling!

✅ VULKAN RENDERER — Improved graphics stability, fixing distorted character models and other rendering issues!

✅ PERFORMANCE OPTIMISATIONS — Recompiled game library reduced from approximately 1.14 GB to 416 MB!

✅ IMPROVED AUDIO — Fixes for distorted sound and background music!

✅ STABILITY IMPROVEMENTS — Resolved several gameplay crashes, saving issues and frozen cutscene animations!

⚠️ Still an experimental fan project, with further optimisations and compatibility improvements planned.

💿 Requires extracted ExeFS and RomFS files from your own copy of the original game. Compilation takes place locally on your PC.

🛠️ Developed by CarlosExabyte, drawing on research from LASRecomp and PokeZ-ARecomp.

⭐ Support the project with a GitHub star!

🔗https://github.com/CarlosExabyte/Arceuszada/releases
